title: Earth Gets Struck by Lightning About 45 Times Every Second

scenes.text: Lightning flashes about 45 times every second on Earth.
That adds up to roughly 1.4 billion flashes in a single year.
About three out of four never touch the ground. They stay inside or between clouds.
Most of the flashes happen over tropical land.
Right now, somewhere on Earth, the sky is lighting up. And it just happened again.

description:
Lightning flashes about 45 times every second on Earth.
That is roughly 1.4 billion flashes a year, and about three in four stay in the clouds.
How close have you been to a strike?
first_comment: 1.4 billion flashes a year. Where is the best storm you have ever watched?
